take: Per the Oilers' announcement, EDM placed forward Zach Hyman on injured reserve. Hyman had one goal in six games this season, against 1.84 expected goals (the number of goals his chances should have produced), and EDM took 47.4% of the 5-on-5 chance quality with him on the ice. Going by how the coach has used his players, Owen Michaels (12:10 a night) is next in line for his second-line minutes, and Kasperi Kapanen is the likeliest to move up on the power play.
